subject: Fastest air freight option: HAM to GRU
body:
Hi there,

Hope your week’s going well! Could you send me an all-in price in EUR for the fastest air freight option from HAM to GRU (Sao Paulo, BR)?

The automotive sensors will be ready on 2026-11-29, and we’ll deliver them to Hamburg airport (HAM) ourselves. It’s 12 pieces with a gross weight of 1353 kg and a total volume of 4.94 cbm.

Could you attach the offer as a PDF to your reply? Our purchasing department needs it for filing.

Thanks for checking!

Thanks a lot and have a lovely day!
Petra Hofmann
Export Desk, Hofmann Textilwerk KG

classification.reasoning: The customer is requesting an all-in price for a new air-freight shipment from HAM to GRU.
